title: Morphine pain killer
author: @GiorgioRegni
description: A relaxing, southing mix of beats that slowly but surely appease any pain point. The brain runs the body as you will discover with this preset.

title: Self Hypnosis
author: @GiorgioRegni
description: Short meditation preset to unite your conscious and subconscious mind. It lasts 20mn : Glide down to theta waves, plateau for 10mn then then slowly come back up to awake state

title: Study and learning
author: @GiorgioRegni
description: A 2h preset that enhances learning, increases ability to concentrate and think clearly, reduces unwillingness to work.  Students can't get enough of this program! This one is to be listened while studying.

title: Schumann Resonance
author: @thegreenman
description: A meditation to put your mind in balance with the Earth. Glide down to Schumann Resonance, low frequency portion of the Earth's electromagnetic field, resonate for 10 minutes then slowly come back up to awake state.

title: Shamanic rhythm
author: @thegreenman
description: Shamanic Drum RhythmBegin at 9hz then glide down to 4.5hz for 50 minutes and back up at the end.

title: Unity
author: @GiorgioRegni
description: Wander in deep relaxing delta waves and let your mind explore freely and without bounds. May induce dreamless sleep and loss of body awareness.

title: Wakeful Relaxation
author: @GiorgioRegni
description: This presets stimulates a wakeful relaxation state with closed eyes. Zen-trained meditation masters produce noticeably more alpha waves during meditation.To be used in short 10 to 15 minutes doses to calm down and concentrate when needed.

title: Astral projection - Relaxation
author: @GiorgioRegni
description: From the book Mastering Astral Projection, Week 1: Relaxation. Use a low to medium sound level, sit in a quiet place, and listen to the preset with eyes closed. A hard-backed chair without neck support is recommended to prevent falling asleep.

title: Lucid dreams
author: @thegreenman
description: This preset stimulates lucid dreaming. It has to be played while sleeping, it is recommend during a nap, while seated in a chair or sofa to prevent falling fully asleep. 5hz base frequency with 8 hz spikes

title: Lucid dreams - variant
author: @thegreenman
description: Sleep Induction and Lucid Dreams 2Sleep Induction into a longer lucid dreaming program

title: Sleep induction
author: @thegreenman
description: Sleep induction for use about 15 mn before bedtime to help you fall asleep. It's a one hour programm, with 6mn drop into delta waves followed by 54 mn of relaxing delta plateau

title: Insomnia Relief
description: Insomnia relief through stimulating Sensory Motor Rythm. Don't use it at bedtime, use it only during your insomnia, for example if you wake up in the middle of the night and can't go back to sleep 38 mn of crossing frequencies from 8 to 12 Hz

title: ADHD
author: @thegreenman
description: This preset is an aid for Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder. It lasts 30mn and alternates between 12 and 20 hz. It can be used whenever needed

title: Creativity
author: @thegreenman
description: It's a 20mn meditation preset to assist in Creative Thinking It begins at 10hz then varying from 8 to 6 hz with a glide back to 8hz at the end

title: Hallucination
author: @GiorgioRegni
description: A fun preset that simulates psychedelic hallucinations.

title: Highest mental activity
author: @GiorgioRegni
description: A quick cafeine boost ! This preset shortly reaches Gamma waves, provides higher mental activity, including perception, problem solving, and consciousness. It can be used whenever needed

title: High Intensity Interval Training
author: @GiorgioRegni
description: This preset is based on a Tabata HIIT protocol, it helps you give your maximum during work periods and recover quicker during rest periods. Starts with 2 minutes warm up then 8 times 20 secs work, 10 secs rest followed by 2 minutes  of cool down. As always use headphones.
